paper: Strat-LLM: Stratified Strategy Alignment for LLM-based Stock Trading with Real-time Multi-Source Signals
claim_boundary: A researcher-authored monthly U.S.-stock analogue of Strat-LLM's price/news/report state, four expert strategy motifs, Free/Guided/Strict alignment modes, regime-dependent scaffolding, buy/hold/sell actions, and next-period execution; not the unreleased prompts, live model calls, intraday inputs, or broker paths.

paper_source.bounded_release_search_checked_2026_09_0: The advertised project page and exact code searches still expose no attributable implementation, data, prompts, or actions.

primary_source_anchors.mechanism: Sequential prices, real-time news, and annual reports form a contamination-free multi-source state before each decision.
S1 short-term reversal, S2 breakout momentum, S3 volatility compression, and S4 price-volume confirmation define the external strategy taxonomy.
Free uses internal intuition, Guided adapts the four strategies to current information, and Strict adheres to them as a risk anchor.
Alignment utility is regime-dependent: flexible modes capture uptrends while Strict mitigates downside in falling markets; no universal model/mode is selected.

alignment_policy.strict_mode: equal mean of the four expert-strategy scores
alignment_policy.guided_mode: equal blend of Free and Strict
alignment_policy.mode_rule: Free above 5%, Guided from 0% through 5%, Strict below 0%
alignment_policy.execution_lag: formation score earns the following monthly return
alignment_policy.common_portfolio_adapter: the selected-mode continuous score enters frozen value-weighted long-short deciles and all six common paths

approximated_elements: JKP characteristics replace intraday prices, live news, and annual-report text
rolling source RankIC replaces model-native intuition
equal motif aggregation replaces incomplete S1-S4 operational rules
a six-month market return defines regime
deterministic regime thresholds select interaction mode
continuous scores replace LLM action rationales
the common monthly adapter replaces next-day-open broker execution
invented_elements: the exact signed JKP source mappings
